topic.title: Build Integration and Validation
topic.shortdesc: Using the plugin from the command line, Gradle builds, and CI/CD pipelines, with EPUBCheck validation.

body.p: The build integrationDITA2ePub plugin integrates with the standard DITA-OT build infrastructure. You can invoke it from the command line, from Gradle or Maven build scripts, or from continuous integration pipelines.

section.title: Command Line Usage
section.p: The simplest invocation uses the DITA-OT dita command:
section.codeblock:
# Minimal build dita --input=bookmap.ditamap --format=epub3
# Full-featured build dita --input=bookmap.ditamap --format=epub3 \ --output=build/epub \ -Depub.cover.image=images/cover.jpg \ -Depub.theme=technical \ -Depub.platform=generic \ -Depub.accessibility=wcag-aa \ -Depub.drop.caps=yes \ -Depub.table.zebra=yes \ -Depub.figure.numbering=chapter \ -Depub.generate.index=auto \ -Depub.generate.glossary=auto \ -Depub.validate=yes
section.p: All parameters use the -Dname=value syntax. Boolean parameters accept yes, true, or 1 (case-insensitive). Add -Ddebug=yes for verbose diagnostic output during transformation.

section.title: Build Pipeline
section.p: The plugin's Ant build pipeline executes these stages in order:

ol.li: Initialize — create output directories, set defaults, validate plugin
Preprocess — DITA-OT preprocessing (resolve conrefs, keyrefs, etc.)
Scan fonts — discover font files in the embed directory
Transform — run the XSLT transformation on the preprocessed map
Copy resources — CSS, images, cover image, fonts
Optimize images — JPEG re-encoding, PNG stripping (if enabled)
Obfuscate fonts — IDPF XOR algorithm (if enabled)
Package — create the EPUB ZIP archive with correct mimetype placement
Validate — run EPUBCheck (if enabled and available)

section.title: EPUBCheck Validation
section.p: EPUBCheckWhen epub.validate=yes (the default), the plugin runs EPUBCheck against the generated EPUB file. EPUBCheck validates:
If EPUBCheck reports errors, the build will fail with a non-zero exit code. Warnings are reported but do not fail the build.
section.note: For CI/CD pipelines, always enable validation to catch regressions early. A passing EPUBCheck run is the strongest guarantee that your EPUB will work across reading systems.

section.title: Image Optimization
section.p: The image optimizationimage optimizer runs when epub.optimize.images=yes. It processes all images in the output directory:

row.entry: Re-encodes to strip metadata; skips files under 50 KB
Optional max-width resize via epub.image.max.width (preserves aspect ratio)

section.p: The optimizer only replaces a file when the optimized version is smaller than the original.
